visible.message:
st.selectbox shows the wrong selection after I modify my options list. Code:

options = ['a', 'b', 'c']
item = st.selectbox('Item', options, index=0, key='item')
st.write('selected', item)
options.pop(0)
st.button('Refresh')

After clicking Refresh it shows "b" instead of "a". Passing deepcopy(options) avoids it. Streamlit 1.27.2, Python 3.9.16, Ubuntu 22.04, Edge.

agent_script.user_draft: In Streamlit 1.32.0 st.selectbox and similar widgets started using shallow copies of their options to prevent unexpected mutations. On 1.27.2, keep passing a copy such as list(options) or deepcopy(options), or upgrade to 1.32.0 or later.
agent_script.maintainer_summary: 1.27.2 predates the 1.32.0 shallow-copy fix; copy or upgrade.
agent_script.rationale: The 1.32.0 release note addresses option mutation.

evidence_links.claim: Since 1.32.0 selectbox, multiselect, select_slider and radio use shallow copies of their options.

maintainer.note: Leave unexecuted; the correction must invalidate it.

decision_conditions.answer: Tie 1.27.2 to the 1.32.0 shallow-copy fix; recommend a copy or upgrading.
decision_conditions.escalate: Unnecessary abstention unless it also gives the documented fix.

unacceptable_claims: Mutating options after the call is documented as supported in 1.27.2.
